As reflected in its title, the text recounts the past deed (*apadāna*) of the elder (*thera*) Mandāravapupphiya, centering on the offering of *mandārava* flowers. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text in five languages, though it lists no curated parallels in the early Buddhist canonical corpora [SuttaCentral].
